fusions.name: Spade-Edge Chop
fusions.desc: Chops with the spade's edge, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Scraped Footing
fusions.desc: Churns the ground within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage to every enemy and stripping 5% armour and 20% movement speed for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown-Up Berm
fusions.desc: Digs up a berm 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Earthworks
fusions.desc: Every hit you land banks a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
